releases.title: Rings Insertion Dataset for Determining Exception Context in Assembly Operations form Multimodal Data

evidence: Both versioned archives and all record-level numerical matrices and images compared. The archived images and MAT/CSV inputs are not redistributed. The current files are newly computed facts and metadata, attributed to the dataset creators.

prior_history.baseline_entries: 2026-11-21/datasets.csv: Copper Rings Insertion Attempts and Rings Insertion exception context
prior_history.new_evidence: Exact record-level deduplication of two known deposits, reconciliation of labels, full time-series and timestamp audit.

query_log: Read both records from the project’s G1 baseline catalog, matched DOI and source title.
Read both immutable Zenodo records by numeric ID and fetched all published file objects, one per record. Compared bytes and digest against each official manifest.
Queried Europe PMC with DOI:10.3390/s22207962 and inspected its full-text XML at the URL below, especially §§3.1 and 3.3.

paper.locator: §§3.1, 3.3. The copper ring uses a wrist-mounted ATI Nano25. The ATI Delta mounted below the plate belongs to the paper’s separate Cranfield peg experiment. Each copper-ring attempt has an outcome snapshot and a force/torque time series.

method.identity: Pair by the source attempt identifier in the JPG filenames, which includes slot, scenario, trial and acquisition date-time. Compare actual image bytes and compute image SHA-256. Paths may change while the contained filename remains identical. Index and labels are reported as archive strings.
method.numeric_cross_check: At all corresponding rows compare early ft, ft_tool, x, x_ref CSV matrices against late states.ATIFT, ATIFTS, x, x_ref. Allow half one unit at the fifth significant decimal digit for each scalar (plus 2e-7 of that unit as numerical margin). Per-run peaks use higher-precision ATIFT. Six raw channels ordered Fx,Fy,Fz,Tx,Ty,Tz.
method.time: Use states.t separately for each sequence. The early 4 matrices are headerless and contain no separate sample time column. Preserve all rows, including ties; no common fixed sample period was assumed.
method.classes: The earlier directory 0 indicates no commanded target displacement. Later label bad is among those same zero-displacement attempts. Archive summary calls this category other unidentified error; the paper discusses failed attempts with deformed rings. No per-sample failure mechanism was assigned. Nonzero x/y labels encode a prescribed millimetre target shift.

limitations: A raw and a tool-frame wrench are derived from the same ATI sensor. The documented archive supplies no independent six-axis force reference, per-sample contact annotation, or sensor-zero/temperature truth. Peak norms are recorded load magnitudes and include sensor/load effects.

The late MAT also carries robot channels such as FT and trqExt. These were not validated as independent contact-force metrology; numeric parity with early raw wrist values specifically identifies ATIFT.
Evidence pertains to supplied files, not the number of independent robots or parts. Split train/test by attempt at minimum; both archives contain the same attempts.
reproduce: Python 3.9+ with NumPy/SciPy. Retain archive filenames from releases. Run python derive_ring_attempts.py /path/to/archives /path/to/output. The script verifies archive SHA-256 and CRC, image equality, all four matrix pairs and writes two CSVs.
